sql: SELECT i.unit, c.bot_data->>'ai_agent' AS ia, (c.bot_data->>'lp_lead_id' IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wapi_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.from_me AND m.timestamp < (SELECT min(m2.timestamp) FROM wapi_messages m2 WHERE m2.conversation_id = c.id AND NOT m2.from_me))) AS comecou_por_nos, count(*) AS n FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE i.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND i.unit IN ('VENDAS 2','VENDAS 3') AND c.created_at > '2026-10-08T17:44:00Z' AND c.remote_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
